meta.methods: N = 64 particles. The target energy is U(x) = ∑j=1,2[(xj2−1)2/(2σ2) + xj2/2], where x = (x1, x2) and σ = 0.3 controls well sharpness. The numerical domain is [−1.9,1.9]2. Green–Bessel: smoothing strength r = 2.05 and length ℓ = 0.1. RBF: adaptive median-bandwidth multiplier 5.33484, selected using an independent sampling discrepancy.
